analysis_md:
$$y=e^{-\int\frac{1}{x}\,dx}\left(\int\frac{\sin x}{x}\cdot e^{\int\frac{1}{x}\,dx}\,dx+C\right)=\frac{1}{x}\left(\int\frac{\sin x}{x}\cdot x\,dx+C\right)=\frac{1}{x}(-\cos x+C)$$

带入初值 $x=\pi,y=1$ 得 $C=\pi-1$
